definition: KnowsNecessary means that all available interpretations have an actual necessarily existing being. KnowsNoNecessary means that all lack one. The model makes both false while a designated actual interpretation has such a being; available interpretations are not metaphysical successors.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
